payload.question: How many unsafe private rented homes did the council get fixed?
payload.label: Private rented homes made safe, 2024/25
payload.council_caveat: The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: Councils can force private landlords to fix dangerous housing. Norwich set itself a target of 50 homes made safe a year and says it will step in below 45. In 2024/25 it reported 22 — less than half the target.
